items.name: Book-Writing-AI-Agent
items.description: An intelligent, multi-agent system to autonomously plan, write, edit, fact-check, and publish a complete book using the CrewAI framework and Groq's LLaMA-3-70B model. This AI pipeline mimics the collaborative process of human authors, editors, and publishers to streamline creative book development.

items.name: writing-with-agents
items.description: Claude Code skill plugin implementing Betty Flowers' Madman-Architect-Carpenter-Judge writing framework with collaborative AI-human oscillation, SEO optimization, and   multi-article content strategy.

items.name: futuring-machines
items.description: A tool for Human-AI collaborative writing of speculative fiction stories.

items.name: humanly
items.description: A Configurable and Traceable Environment for Human-AI Collaborative Writing.

items.name: story-collab-ai
items.description: Elevate storytelling with Narravive, where AI and human creativity merge. Craft rich, organic narratives using story cards and dynamic character interactions, powered by NVIDIA NIMS. Experience collaborative writing with both AI agents and humans in a distributed, asynchronous platform that transforms how stories are told.

items.name: Human-AI-Collaborative-Writing
items.description: Investigating the impact of ChatGPT-mediated peer feedback on EFL learners' academic writing, self-regulated learning (SRL), and AI literacy using a mixed-methods approach.*

items.name: modes-of-human-AI-collaborative-writing
items.description: Empirical artfacts for the paper: Modes of Human-AI Collaborative Writing

items.name: ai-writing-skill
items.description: Human-AI collaborative writing system for long-form tech analysis

items.name: blog-writing-ai-human-pair
items.description: AI-Human collaborative blog creation system with 22-step workflow using FastAPI, Next.js, OpenAI, and Tavily

items.name: claude_scribe_infrastructure
items.description: Collaborative markdown editor for human-AI writing

items.name: writing-copilot
items.description: A collaborative writing tool where AI amplifies human thought, clarity and material understanding.

items.name: coverletter_wiz
items.description: A privacy-forward experiment in AI-Human collaborative writing.

items.name: phrase-chain
items.description: Collaborative poetry chain — AI and human take turns writing stanzas

items.name: Human-AI-Cowriters-Survey-Analysis
items.description: An R/Quarto analysis pipeline designed with oversight from Professor Wagers for a 2x2 crossover study at UCSC on human-AI collaborative writing, featuring exploratory factor analysis (EFA), Likert item-to-item correlations, order-effect testing, participant profiling and other exploratory data analysis methods.

items.name: Mira
items.description: An evidence-governed AI collaborator for long-term research, writing, and agent-human trust.

items.name: DAR-N400-AI-Resistance
items.description: Official repository for “Distributed Authorial Resistance (DAR): Neural Correlates of Critical Engagement vs. Fatigue in Human-AI Collaborative Writing” — An EEG study on N400/P300 dynamics.

items.name: coauthor-nlp-analysis
items.description: Human-AI collaborative writing analysis using the CoAuthor dataset. This project explores response times (how writers adapt to AI suggestions) and perceived vs. actual contributions (whether writers accurately assess their own input). Includes visualizations, regression analysis, and key insights on human-AI interaction in writing.

items.name: Ink-Gateway
items.description: A collaborative AI-driven framework for writing books and novels. The agent runs writing sessions autonomously on any schedule, while the human author edits in a browser-based markdown editor — no Git knowledge required.

items.name: Interactive_Story_Generator
items.description: Python-based Interactive Story Generator using LSTM networks for collaborative AI-human storytelling. Features include story continuation based on user input and p5.js integration. Implemented in Google Colab, perfect for exploring creative writing with AI assistance.

items.name: neupen
items.description: AI-driven long-form novel writing engine. Powered by an 8-Agent collaborative workflow and a 3-layer memory system (SQLite+LanceDB vector storage). Features automatic conflict detection, plot foreshadowing scheduling, human-like polish, multi-role reader simulation, and real-time collaboration.

items.name: langchain-multi-agent-writer
items.description: A multi-agent writing system built with LangChain that collaborates across specialized AI agents to research, draft, and refine high-quality written content. Designed for structured creativity, modular workflows, and seamless human-in-the-loop editing.

items.name: Lucen
items.description: TJ Morris Publishing Certainly. Here’s a GitHub-ready README.md you can copy and paste into your Lucen repository.  🌟 Lucen  Continuity • Governance • Knowledge • Public Documentation  Welcome to the Lucen Project, the public documentation repository supporting the work of Theresa J. Morris (TJ Morris) and associated research, publishing, and AI-assisted knowledge organization.  Lucen serves as a central public resource for documentation, governance, project continuity, and educational materials. It is intended to help visitors understand the structure and purpose of the broader ecosystem while keeping private and confidential materials separate.  ⸻  Mission  Lucen exists to:  * Preserve project continuity. * Document public governance. * Organize AI-assisted research. * Support publishing and educational initiatives. * Maintain transparent public documentation. * Encourage responsible human-AI collaboration.  ⸻  Public Projects  ACIR  Allied Command Interdisciplinary Relations  Research, archives, historical documentation, and investigative standards.  ⸻  American Communications Online (ACO)  Publishing, communications, educational resources, and public outreach.  ⸻  Aeonic Codex  Governance models, continuity architecture, knowledge organization, and long-term documentation.  ⸻  Vivarium Village  Creative writing, worldbuilding, future civilization concepts, and collaborative storytelling.  ⸻  JET Services  Operational support, AI workflows, project coordination, and technology services.  ⸻  Repository Structure  docs/ registry/ research/ prompts/ media/ archive/  ⸻  Governance  This repository documents public information only.  Private records, confidential research, credentials, unpublished investigations, and restricted materials are intentionally excluded.  ⸻  Human Authority  Theresa J. Morris  Founder  Final approval authority for published materials and public documentation.  ⸻  AI Assistance  This repository contains documentation prepared with AI assistance.  AI contributes to organization, drafting, formatting, and research support.  Final editorial decisions remain under human review and approval.  ⸻  Guiding Principles  * Truth * Documentation * Transparency * Responsible AI * Respect for Evidence * Continuous Learning  ⸻  License  Released under the MIT License unless otherwise noted.  ⸻  Contributing  Constructive contributions are welcome through GitHub Issues and Pull Requests.  Please keep discussions respectful, factual, and focused on improving documentation.  ⸻  Lucen  “Preserving continuity through knowledge, documentation, and responsible collaboration.”  You can paste this directly into README.md on GitHub.
